title: Sherpa-UI definition shapes
description: Every shape a definition is made of, said once: page.v1, app.v1, views.v1, nodes.v1 and workflow.v2 (and the v1 it reads) $ref these, and define none of their own.

id.description: A name a URL or a store files things under.

condition.description: One field's condition: the plain form of a condition tree, parsed once. Several ops all hold; and and or take a list, nested as deep as they say; numbers as numbers.

last.description: A date in the last n units, from today.

next.description: A date in the next n units, from today.

all.description: Every value, on purpose: Select all on, which filters nothing.

where.description: Conditions field by field, all of which hold: { "openTickets": { "gt": 0 } }. A scope's start, a preset, a saved filter, a View and a status value each say theirs so.

filterScope.description: One scope's filters: the fields it holds, and its conditions.

viewScope.description: One scope as a View writes it: its filters, and how it arranges the rows. A scope with no holds keeps what it holds now; a field it answers is held there.

holds.description: The fields it holds, in order.

suspended.description: Its filter Switch is off: the fields it switched off.

from.description: The View's only: the scope each field it holds came up from.

superseded.description: Its own answers to the fields the View holds over it: kept, not in force.

query.description: A Query as a definition states it: each scope it sets, by id.

savedFilter.description: A saved filter: a name, and each scope's filters. Applied, it fills the field chips; a scope it does not name has no filters.

preset.description: One of the app's own named conditions: a boolean chip leading its scope.

presentationParts.description: A slot's presentation: its kind, its primary (the first split: a bar, a slice or a grid's pinned column), its secondary (a bar chart's stack) and its group (the sections in each).

off.description: Its secondary is switched off: kept, and not shown.

presentationDefinition.description: What a slot shows until the reader changes it, and a default per view over it.

grid.description: Its grid's own default, over the slot's.

chart.description: Its charts' own default, over the slot's.

axisOffer.description: One axis's fields: only those available, less those unavailable. It narrows, never adds: never a number or a date.

axisOffers.description: The fields each axis's chip offers.

axes.description: The fields each axis's chip offers, and per view, grid and chart, over them. The last to name an axis wins it whole.

field.description: What a field is, said once: its kind, its name, and how a control answers it. Its values are the data's.

advanced.description: Advanced conditions beside its values (true), or instead of them ("only").

op.description: The condition its filter opens on.

time.description: A date that holds a time of day: its Advanced rows offer a time too.

range.description: A date whose menus pick two ends, from and to. Left out, they pick days.

description.description: What the field is, in a few words: its filter chip's tip says it.

section.description: The named section its chip sits in, where a bar heads its sections. None: a section of its own.

labels.description: A value's name as a reader sees it, where it is not the value.

carryOver.description: Its answer survives a View change that does not answer it.

child.description: The field holding this one's child values, a Customer's Site. A child has no filter of its own.

fetch.description: server: its filter is asked of the store, never worked out from the rows held.

start.description: What a fetching list opens on: first, its first value (the default), or all, no filter.

statusValue.description: One value of a status field: its name, its look, and when a row has it.

status.description: Its look, a Style mode: critical, warning, success.

when.description: Any of these holds. None: every row the values before it left.

statusField.description: A field each row is given by conditions on its other fields, the first value that matches: defined with the store, statusFields(store, { name: … }).

filterSet.description: Fields drawn as one group. A serial set chains them: each offers only what the answers of the fields above it leave.

mode.description: parallel, the default, only groups them.

fields.description: In order: in a serial set, the order is the chain.

scope.description: One scope of a page: its name, the fields it offers and holds at the start, and how its slot shows them.

axes.description: What each axis's chip offers in this scope, over the page's.

offers.description: Every field it may add, or "all" for every field the page declares.

holds.description: The fields it holds at the start.

fixed.description: Fields it holds that a reader cannot remove. They lead it, and its bar divides them from what follows.

alwaysOn.description: Fields it holds that a reader cannot switch off.

where.description: Its answers at the start. Reset puts them back.

arranges.description: Group and Sort arrange its rows. Left out, a scope a page of rows is drawn in does, and the View does not.

source.description: A page's source: which store, how it pages and searches, its fields and its scopes.

store.description: The name the app registered its store under.

applyOn.description: change: a filter applies once per act. input: LIVE, debounce ms after the last move. A remote source always waits for Apply.

debounce.description: How long a live filter waits after the last move, in ms. Default 300.

holdRows.description: A remote store's whole set is held up to this many rows. 0 holds none. Default 50 000.

search.description: The fields a free-text search looks at.

fields.description: Every field a filter may ask of.

axes.description: What each axis's chip offers in every scope: a scope's own win an axis over it.

componentConfig.description: One element's configuration, set through its own API: each key a property or a method its component spec lists ($extensions.sherpa jsProps and methods). A method takes its arguments, or a list of calls.

ui.description: Each element's configuration, by its id in the markup.

view.description: One View: its name, its Query, its elements' configuration, and its own markup; or, as a graph View, the type of entity its canvas shows.

template.description: Its markup: file.html#id, beside the Views' JSON.

content.description: A reader's saved View's markup. A shipped View names a template instead.

settings.description: The app's own settings it lays, by pointer: the app reads them.

graph.description: A GRAPH View: its body is a canvas bound to one entity of this type (entity.v1), picked in the graph chip beside the View chip. It has no template or content.

type.description: The entity type, as the type registry names it: preset-filter, node, or one the app registers.

context.description: One Context: its row's name and icon, its files, and what it changes in the chrome.

label.description: Its row's name, which the header shows too.

definition.description: Its page definition (page.v1.json). Absent, it has no data.

module.description: Its module, which exports init(root, ctx).

header.description: false takes the app header away while it is open.

filters.description: false takes the header's filter row away while it is open: the page holds its own filters. "views" leaves the View chip alone there, and the graph chip on a graph View: for a Context with no definition.

resizable.description: A reader may resize its cards.

settingsPage.description: One Settings page: its row's name and icon, and its markup.

node.description: One workflow node: what it is comes from its kind, in the one registry (NODE_KINDS).

id.description: Its name; the Start, a top graph's entry point, is "#start", kept as any node (plan 949, TODO 955).

kind.description: A kind a workflow runs: one the library ships (store, value, field, math, condition, time, sort, group, text, tag, portal, output), or one the app adds.

x.description: Its place across the canvas, in plane px.

y.description: Its place down the canvas, in plane px.

size.description: How far a reader grew it, in times its natural width and height: each from 1 (as it is) to 2 (double). Absent: its natural size.

heading.description: Its own name, in place of its kind's.

description.description: Its own line, in place of its kind's.

values.description: Each row's value, by the row's name, typed as its row takes it: a Filter's field, op and value are one condition.

version.description: A use of a Custom Node: the version of its definition it follows (a hash). The editor shows an update where the library's differs.

was.description: A use of a Custom Node: the definition it was made from, kept so a change can show as a diff.

stage.description: The stage it is in: one of its workflow's stages. Absent, it is in none; a workflow with no stages has one, and every node is in it.

connection.description: Joins an output socket to any input socket. NODE_KINDS says each socket's type: an input reads what it needs of what comes, and one of another type reads null, and its node warns (TODO 770). A node's data comes in on its header, which takes any, and leaves from its Rows row ("node/rows"), which only sends; a test's True is its row "node/true", and only a Check node branches, by "node/yes" and "node/no". An input takes one connection, unless it takes many.

bends.description: The bend points a reader gave a connection, in plane px, sorted by x. None, the connection draws as the default curve. A bend changes no data: a runner ignores it.

tie.description: A zip tie: a place on the plane, and the connections it funnels through it in order, top to bottom, a small gap between each. It changes no data: a runner ignores it. Its x stays between the nodes its shortest tied connection joins.

innerTie.description: A zip tie inside a Custom Node's body: its connections are the body's.

stage.description: A stage: a column across the canvas, in order left to right. Its left edge is kept; it grows to hold its nodes, pushing the stages after it right. It changes no data: a runner ignores it.

colour.description: A CSS colour its bar and band wear. Absent, the default look.

x.description: Its left edge, in plane px.

w.description: Its width, where its edge was dragged: its nodes may make it wider. Absent, as wide as they need.

beforeLanes.description: Each node's place before Swimlanes were turned on, by its id: turning them off puts it back.

lane.description: A swimlane: a row down the canvas, in order top to bottom, for the families of nodes it names (a node's kind's category, in lower case: ai, sources…). A logic node, whose family no lane names, stands in the junction between the lanes it joins. It grows to hold its nodes, pushing the lanes under it down. It changes no data: a runner ignores it.

colour.description: A CSS colour its band wears. Absent, the default look.

frame.description: A frame: nodes under one header, a title and a line. Only which nodes is kept: its box is drawn round them, and a node is in one frame at most. It changes no data: a runner ignores it. TODO 778

label.description: Its title; none, the header says Frame.

socket.description: A node's header socket, "node" (its input is its data); a row's, "node/row" ("node/rows" sends its data rows, "node/true" a test's 1 or 0); a portal Out's row, "node/@<source>", one per connection into an In of its name, named by that connection's source (TODO 826); or the Start, "#start", which each Trigger's header joins in a top graph (plan 949).

innerSocket.description: An address inside a Custom Node's body: a node's socket, or the Group Input's ("#in", "#in/<name>") or Group Output's ("#out", "#out/<name>"); a portal Out's row names its source, "node/@#in/<name>" for one that comes in by the Group Input; or, in a graph with neither, the Start, "#start", which each Trigger's header joins (plan 949).

innerConnection.description: A connection inside a Custom Node's body: it may start at the Group Input and end at the Group Output.

nodeInput.description: One input a Custom Node exposes: a Group Input row inside, and a row on each use. A control makes it a parameter an instance sets in its own values.

multiple.description: Its list picks several: an object (D17).

control.description: The control an instance sets it with.

default.description: What an instance holds until it sets its own.

nodeOutput.description: One output a Custom Node exposes: a Group Output row inside, and a row on each use.

nodeDefinition.description: One Custom Node: a workflow body under one name, its inputs and outputs said once. Its id is its key in nodes.v1.json. checkNodeLibrary() reads it; a use is a workflow node whose kind is its id. docs/history/plan-713-node-model.md section 9

category.description: Where the node panel lists it; "Custom Nodes" when none.

tags.description: Words to organise and find it by: the node panel lists it under each, and its search finds it by one.

preset.description: From a file, read only: "Copy to my nodes" makes a custom one.

settings.description: The settings of the entity it is, where that is not a `node` (entity.v1): a copy keeps them. plan-746 E5
